{

 "content": "from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    """Fill each enclosed background cavity: 2 for even-by-even dimensions, else 7."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue

            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            touches_edge = False

            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                if y in (0, h - 1) or x in (0, w - 1):
                    touches_edge = True
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                            grid[yy][xx] == bg and (yy, xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))

            if not touches_edge:
                rows = [y for y, _ in cells]
                cols = [x for _, x in cells]
                height = max(rows) - min(rows) + 1
                width = max(cols) - min(cols) + 1
                fill = 2 if height % 2 == 0 and width % 2 == 0 else 7
                for y, x in cells:
                    out[y][x] = fill

    return out
"
